title: An idea in the ledger: a hypothesis for reaching the project's goal, its fate in the council, what the person decided and what happened when it was tried

proposedBy.description: The role that proposed it, such as search or outsider

effect.description: What moves, and by about how much

trigger.description: What was seen that led to the idea

killCondition.description: The result that would prove it wrong

parent.description: The idea this one is a narrower form of

returns.description: An earlier idea, killed or rejected, that this one brings back

whatChanged.description: What is different since the idea it returns as was killed or rejected

upside.description: The venture board's or the invention lab's word on what an idea is worth if it works

riskiest.description: The venture board's or the invention lab's word on the assumption most likely to be false

newTo.description: The invention lab's word on how new an invention is: nothing like it anywhere, new to things of its kind, or new only to this one

feasible.description: The invention lab's word on whether the thing as it is built could do it

swap.description: The design studio's swap test: with a rival's name on it the direction would be wrong (own), or it would fit any business of the trade, or almost any business

madeFrom.description: The design studio's word on what a direction is made from: something the business has, one idea about it, a field far from the web, or known patterns of the web joined

signature.description: The design studio's ruling on a direction's signature moment

scale.description: How far the idea reaches. The council and the venture board: a change to what is there, something new beside it, a remake of what is there, or something the business does not do or have at all. The invention lab: a new capability inside the thing, a new thing built from it, or a remake of how it works. The design studio: a new look on the structure the site has, a new structure as well, or a site of a different kind

novelty.description: The judge's word at the docket: fresh when it could only come from looking at this project and its market, familiar when any adviser would give it to any firm of this kind

priorArt.description: What the proposer found when it looked for the idea elsewhere before proposing it

searched.description: How and where it was looked for

who.description: Who already does it, or something close

difference.description: How this idea differs from what exists

origin.description: The skill whose session proposed it; council when missing

ventureCandidate.description: Killed or narrowed in the council for reaching further than it could test: worth taking to the venture board

where.description: The places the idea applies to, so a reader can see them

part.description: The part of the page, in plain words

text.description: Words shown in that part, to find it

selector.description: A CSS selector for that part

what.description: The cheapest way to find out

checkAfter.description: How long after the change to look, such as six weeks

liveSince.description: The day the change went live, as the person said it; the wait is counted from it

plannedIn.description: The roadmap fix plan that adopted it
